comparison.objective: Feed flexible filament at least 2 cm into a 3D-printer feeder.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual straightening and insertion of a slender springy filament into a narrow funnel and bore.
comparison.success_condition: End ≥2 cm deep, on axis, released and still for 1 s; kinking, spool loss, or falling zeros the trial.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable linear insertion and kink prevention, not rigid-body sifting.
